source: immutable sourcePayload + sourceDomainRefs, not mutable RegisterRecord
rules: Finalization validates form data schema, statutory language and signature roles.
Signed payload and render bytes never change; corrections create a new snapshot with supersedesId.
Historical source versions are retained and are valid for re-rendering even after live revisions change.
Template bytes/hash/version and renderer version are preserved with the source payload.
Repeat tables paginate with repeated headers and per-page DOUL footer.
Canonical payload hash is reproducible; output renderHash hashes actual output bytes, not source JSON.
official_template_policy: Block statutory fixed-form rendering until original template, checksum, fields and verified effective dates are installed.
